text:
Kara (PM): Quick UX nit: the console shows 'Retention: 30d' and 'KMS: BYOK' on one line. Customers are asking what happens if a route override exists or if a key is disabled. Screenshot: https://redwood/mock/retention_kms
Theo (Design): Agree. Propose compact two-line summary:
Policy: 30 days
Effective: 12 days (route: event-ingest)
Also expand KMS label to 'Customer‑managed key (BYOK)' on first render.
Mina (Security): Strong +1. Audit log entries need clearer verbs and event codes. Current 'kms_update by x' is ambiguous. Recommend human message + machine code, e.g. kms.rotate -> 'KMS key rotated — user: x (console)'. Include key_fingerprint in metadata.
Ibrahim (Frontend): Implementation notes: add i18n keys settings.kms.full_label and settings.retention.summary_compact; use aria-describedby for the 'What's this?' link. For audit rows add data-event-code and data-key-fingerprint attributes for SIEM.
Theo (Design): Microcopy options to iterate:
1) 'Policy: 30d · Effective: 12d (route override)'
2) 'Policy 30 days — Effective 12 days (overridden)'
KMS pill copy: 'Customer‑managed key (BYOK) — Active' (with lock icon).
Kara (PM): Accessibility: don't rely on color. Add an icon + explicit text and ensure contrast (navy bg + white text for active).
Mina (Security): Also add audit schema snippet to docs: {"event_code":"kms.rotate","message":"KMS key rotated","user":"alice@example.com","method":"console","key_fingerprint":"ab:cd:ef"} (machine-readable only in logs).
deploy-bot: Microcopy PR #522 scheduled to staging at 1960012355.
Ibrahim (Frontend): I'll open the PR with aria changes and data attributes behind a feature flag. ETA tomorrow midday.
